title: Increase Services card box transparency to ~20% for selected elements

requirements.text:
Update ONLY the 13 user-selected elements within the Services section (section[2] service cards) so the white box/background fill is approximately 20% opacity (i.e., Tailwind equivalent `bg-white/20`), increasing from the current ~5% opacity. Apply this change only to the elements identified by these XPaths and do not change any other elements or sections:
1) /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/main[1]/section[2]/div[1]/div[2]/div[1]/div[3]/div[2]/div[1]
2) /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/main[1]/section[2]/div[1]/div[2]/div[1]/div[3]/div[1]/div[2]
3) /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/main[1]/section[2]/div[1]/div[2]/div[2]/div[3]/div[2]/div[1]

quotes: make the boxes more of maybe a 20% transparency

acceptanceCriteria: Only the 13 specified elements have their white overlay/background opacity changed to ~20% (e.g., Tailwind `bg-white/20`).
No other elements in the Services section (including the full-card gradient overlay) are modified.
No other sections/pages/components are visually or structurally changed.
Service-card text readability improves due to the stronger (less transparent) white box fill on the selected elements.

constraints: Apply the transparency/opacity change ONLY to the 13 elements specified by the provided XPath list.
Do not modify any other elements in the Services section outside the selected elements.
Do not edit files under the immutable frontend paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT (not needed for this change).
nonGoals: Do not change service background images, icon choices, or service copy.
Do not alter the overall layout/responsiveness of the Services grid.
Do not change global theme tokens or typography outside the selected elements.
